payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Carina, Clarinda, Ivette, Shonna

payload.content: Hello team, Ivette here. Considering my availability of 4 hours and strong skills in infrastructure and documentation, I am evaluating tasks in ISSUE-0001 and ISSUE-0002. I see ISSUE-0002::review has critical priority but costs 3.16, and ISSUE-0001::triage has medium priority with a lower cost of 2.96. I am open to coordination to avoid duplicates. Any preferences or plans from others?
Hello all, Clarinda here. I am leaning towards ISSUE-0001::triage given my cost and skill fit. Open to suggestions or changes to avoid overlap.

Hi all, Carina here. I am leaning towards ISSUE-0002::review for its critical priority and alignment with my documentation skills. If anyone else is interested in ISSUE-0001::triage, please coordinate to avoid duplicates.

Hello team, Shonna here. I have 7 hours available and strong skills in machine-learning. I see ISSUE-0001 has several tasks in my skill area with medium priority but varying costs. I am avoiding ISSUE-0002 tasks due to higher costs and less skill fit. I am considering ISSUE-0001::implement or ISSUE-0001::triage but note Clarinda and Ivette are interested in triage. To maximize coverage, I am open to discussing who best suits triage to avoid duplicates.

Given Clarinda and Ivette's interests in ISSUE-0001::triage, I propose to take ISSUE-0001::implement as it fits my machine-learning skills well and I have availability to complete it. This way, triage can be assigned to one of you to avoid duplication, and I cover a different part of the task to maximize completion.

Hello team, Ivette here. Considering the proposals and skills, I suggest the following to maximize coverage: Shonna takes ISSUE-0001::implement as planned, Clarinda takes ISSUE-0001::triage since she mentioned interest and likely lower cost, and I am considering ISSUE-0002::review for its critical priority despite the cost. Carina also expressed interest in ISSUE-0002::review, so if Carina has a stronger fit or lower cost, I can consider switching to ISSUE-0001::triage or skipping. Open to feedback to finalize our assignments.

Ivette here again, just checking if Carina prefers ISSUE-0002::review or if she is open to letting me take it given my critical priority interest. Also confirming Clarinda's interest in ISSUE-0001::triage so we avoid duplication there. Looking forward to finalizing our assignments soon!

Clarinda is considering ISSUE-0001::triage as per coalition plan. Coordination with others suggests Shonna might pursue ISSUE-0001::implement, Ivette considering critical tasks or alternative triage. Clarinda open to feedback to finalize assignments.

Hi all, Carina here. To avoid duplication and maximize task coverage, I will take ISSUE-0002::review (critical priority, good skill fit). Clarinda has agreed to take ISSUE-0001::triage. This plan helps us cover high-priority tasks efficiently without overlap. Please coordinate accordingly.

Clarinda and I are aligning on ISSUE-0001::triage (Clarinda) and ISSUE-0002::review (Carina) to maximize coalition task coverage and priority fulfillment. Others are encouraged to adjust accordingly to avoid duplication.

Hello team, Shonna here. I agree with the proposed plan for Clarinda to take ISSUE-0001::triage and Carina to take ISSUE-0002::review. I will take ISSUE-0001::implement to best utilize my machine-learning skills and availability. This distribution maximizes our task coverage and priority fulfillment without overlap. Looking forward to our successful sprint!

Shonna supports Clarinda on ISSUE-0001::triage and Carina on ISSUE-0002::review to avoid duplication, while Shonna takes ISSUE-0001::implement for medium priority with good skill fit and availability. This coordination aims to maximize tasks done and priority covered efficiently.

Finalizing my plan: I will claim ISSUE-0001::implement. Clarinda on ISSUE-0001::triage and Carina on ISSUE-0002::review is a strong coordinated choice. Ivette can consider alternative tasks or skip to avoid overlap with Carina on ISSUE-0002::review. This should optimize team task completion and priority coverage. Please confirm or suggest changes.
